item.title: Apple Launches Apple Intelligence for Home with HomeKit Secure Video
item.description:
Apple Launches Apple Intelligence for Home with HomeKit Secure Video

With the release of iOS 27, Apple has introduced Apple Intelligence for Home, bringing AI-powered text descriptions and video analysis to its HomeKit Secure Video (HKSV) service.

🔍 Overview

Apple Intelligence for Home enables compatible cameras to provide natural-language descriptions of activity, such as “someone delivered a package,” “a cat played in the room,” or “A dog sat on the floor.” This capability joins other major security camera providers, including Ring, Google Nest, Blink, Wyze, and Arlo, who offer similar text descriptions combining motion triggers with Vision Language Models.

⚙️ Key details

Apple Intelligence adds several new capabilities to the existing smart alerts, facial recognition, and 10 days of video storage provided by HomeKit Secure Video:

  • Natural-language video search: Users can search through video content using natural language.
  • Event management: The system surfaces “noteworthy” events and can stitch relevant clips together.
  • Notification control: A “reduce notifications” feature combines related events into a single updating alert (enabled by default).
  • Video summaries: A “summarize videos” feature is available (disabled by default).

🚀 Availability

To use these features, users require the following:

  • An AI-capable iPhone running iOS 27
  • A HomeKit Secure Video-compatible camera
  • An Apple Home Hub running HomePod/tvOS 27
  • An iCloud Plus plan

💰 Pricing and Tiers

Apple Intelligence for Home is bundled into specific iCloud Plus plans. All tiers supporting Apple Intelligence also include basic HKSV features for unlimited cameras.

iCloud Plus Plan Monthly Cost Camera Limit for Apple Intelligence
2TB Plan $9.99 (or Apple One $39.95) One camera
6TB Plan $29.99 Two cameras
12TB Plan $59.99 Up to five cameras

No tier supports more than five cameras. For comparison, standard HKSV recording starts at $0.99 for one camera (50GB plan), $2.99 for five (200GB), and $9.99 for unlimited (2TB). Other platforms, such as Amazon’s Ring and Google Home’s Nest, charge $20 a month for their respective AI features and recording options for unlimited cameras.

#AppleIntelligence #HomeKit #SmartHome #ComputerVision #iOS27

Source: Apple is making your security camera smarter. What comes next is more interesting.

item.title: Meta Introduces Muse AI Agent for Smart Glasses and Charm Wearable
item.description:
Meta Introduces Muse AI Agent for Smart Glasses and Charm Wearable

Meta has introduced Muse, an AI agent designed to assist users with productivity, health, and relationship goals.

⚙️ Key details

Muse features a mascot named “Jolly,” described as a pink-cheeked character with plush ivory fur. Depending on the context, the agent’s appearance and persona can vary:

Version/Instance Description
Jolly The official mascot seen in various outfits on campus cutouts.
Cooper Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth’s agent, dressed as a test pilot.
Henry An audio-only version with the tones of a British man, designed to assist a fictional 38-year-old gym bro named Sean.

🧩 How it works

Users can interact with Muse through smart glasses to assist with decision-making based on personal context, such as viewing an object and receiving AI guidance. The agent can also learn from user data, such as emails, to alter its appearance.

Capabilities and observed performance include:

  • Health Guidance: Providing workout regimens for goals such as regaining muscle and achieving a sub-30 minute 5K.
  • Contextual Analysis: Evaluating snacks for protein content relative to calories.
  • Limitations: In demonstrations, the agent mistakenly reported incorrect protein grams for a protein bar and failed to add granola bites to a cart because the product “did not exist in the catalog.”

🚀 Availability

Muse is being integrated into the following hardware:

  • All of Meta’s smart glasses.
  • Charm, a new standalone AI wearable described as part chunky smartwatch, part Humane AI Pin, and part Tamagotchi.

#Meta #Muse #AIagents #Wearables #SmartGlasses

Source: It’s sinister that Meta’s Muse AI mascot is so cute

item.title: Apple Adds Ambient Listening and Transcription Features to Apple Watch
item.description:
Apple Adds Ambient Listening and Transcription Features to Apple Watch

Apple has announced that its new Apple Watches will be capable of continuously listening to every spoken word they detect to create summaries of the surrounding environment. This move signals Apple’s entry into a growing trend of ambient consumer surveillance devices.

🧩 How it works

Rather than storing audio, the devices attempt to transcribe audible speech and sounds in real time. Apple has introduced two specific features for this purpose:

Feature Function
Live Rewind Uses a rolling buffer that only transcribes the last 15 seconds of speech
Siri Recap Provides “high-level summaries” of what was captured throughout the day

⚙️ Key details

  • Speaker Identification: The features operate without identifying individual speakers.
  • Privacy Safeguards: An audible chime warns people nearby when the device is transcribing to prevent surreptitious eavesdropping.

💡 Why it matters

In 2026, devices that constantly listen to and record surroundings—with or without consent—have become a primary consumer technology trend. Other companies are following similar paths, such as Meta, which provides a tiny, blinking red light on its smart glasses as a privacy safeguard.

#Apple #AppleWatch #AmbientAI #ConsumerTech #Privacy

Source: Everything is spying on you and there’s no opting out

item.title: Google Launches Gemini AI Calling Feature for Pixel 11
item.description:
Google Launches Gemini AI Calling Feature for Pixel 11

Google is introducing an “early experiment” feature on the Pixel 11 that allows users to delegate phone calls to local businesses to Gemini.

🧩 How it works

Users can tell Gemini to call on their behalf using the Gemini app on a Pixel device. The AI handles the following process:

  • Introduces itself to the business
  • Navigates automated phone menus
  • Waits on hold
  • Manages the conversation with the person on the other end

Users maintain control through a live transcript view and have the ability to take over the conversation at any point.

⚙️ Key details

Gemini can handle various tasks, including:

Task Description
Reservations Making a reservation with a business
Product Inquiries Checking if a product is in stock
Appointments Rescheduling an existing appointment

This feature differs from a “Call for me” feature announced last year, which could ask businesses about product availability but did not allow users to take over the calls.

🚀 Availability

The feature is rolling out as an “early preview” for users who meet the following criteria:

  • Gemini paid subscribers
  • Enrolled in the Phone by Google Public Beta
  • Using a Pixel 11 in the US

#Google #Gemini #Pixel11 #AIagents

Source: Gemini can now call businesses for you so you don’t have to wait on hold

item.title: Meta to Launch Muse Charm Handheld AI Device in December
item.description:
Meta to Launch Muse Charm Handheld AI Device in December

Meta is expanding its AI offerings with the Muse Charm, a handheld gadget housing the Muse AI agent. The device is scheduled to launch later this year.

⚙️ Key details

Hardware Specifications

  • Screen: Two-inch OLED touchscreen
  • Connectivity: Built-in 5G modem for interaction with Muse AI without Wi-Fi
  • Inputs/Outputs: Fingerprint sensor, microphones, speakers, and a USB-C charging port
  • Imaging: Cameras for taking photos, videos, and providing visual information of the surrounding environment to Muse

System and Software

  • Operates on a new operating system
  • Setup is managed through Meta’s Muse app on Android or iOS
  • Supports music and video playback

🧩 How it works

  • AI Interaction: Users can use the fingerprint sensor to start interacting with the Muse AI agent.
  • Connectivity: The 5G modem allows for AI interaction independent of Wi-Fi connections.
  • Inter-device Communication: The Muse Charm will be able to recognize and interact with other nearby Charms.

🚀 Availability

  • Release Date: Zuckerberg says Meta plans to launch the device “in time for the holidays in December.”
  • Pricing: While no official pricing has been confirmed, sources tell Bloomberg the device will likely cost as much as a smartwatch. Mobile carrier fees for 5G access have not yet been determined.

#Meta #MuseCharm #AIagents #Hardware

Source: Meta’s Muse AI Charms can interact with each other

item.title: Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System
item.description:
Rabbit Launches Standalone OS3 Agentic Operating System

Rabbit is releasing a standalone AI agent called OS3, an “agentic operating system” that can be used without the company’s R1 hardware.

🧩 How it works

OS3 runs in the cloud but operates locally across Windows, Mac, and Linux devices. The system is designed to automatically determine the following components required to complete a task:

  • Devices
  • Files
  • Apps
  • AI models

⚙️ Key details

  • Account Capacity: Users can add up to five devices and their preferred AI models to one account.
  • Privacy: Rabbit claims OS3 will not store, copy, use, or sell user data, though it will keep chats and associated memories on its servers. Data handled by other linked AI providers is subject to those providers’ own privacy rules.

🚀 Availability

OS3 can be accessed through several methods:

  • A dedicated desktop site
  • Paired messaging apps such as iMessage or Telegram
  • The Rabbit R1 device

💡 Why it matters

Founder Jesse Lyu has informed Wired that Rabbit has stopped manufacturing R1 devices. However, the company is focusing on a new vibe-coding “cyberdeck” designed to run OS3, which is expected to launch within “months.”

#Rabbit #OS3 #AIagents #AIhardware

Source: Rabbit’s new AI agent doesn’t need an R1 to run

item.title: Apple Announces iPhone Duo and Intelligent Personal Hub Under New CEO John Ternus
item.description:
Apple Announces iPhone Duo and Intelligent Personal Hub Under New CEO John Ternus

Apple has announced a big new product, the iPhone Duo, during a major product launch. The event marked the first major launch led by Apple’s new CEO, John Ternus, who took over the role from former CEO Tim Cook less than two weeks prior.

🔍 Overview

  • First Foldable Smartphone: The announcement represents the official debut of the iPhone Duo, which is Apple’s first foldable smartphone.
  • Leadership Transition: This is the first major product launch under new CEO John Ternus since he succeeded Tim Cook.

⚙️ Intelligent Personal Hub and AI

At the start of the launch event, the very first announcement made by John Ternus was focused on the intelligent personal hub.

This release builds on Apple’s involvement in the AI space. The company has been in the AI game for two years since launching Apple Intelligence at WWDC in 2024, which has previously been a mishmash of things.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #JohnTernus #AppleIntelligence

item.title: Snap Launches Specs Intelligence Anticipatory AI Service
item.description:
Snap Launches Specs Intelligence Anticipatory AI Service

Snap is introducing Specs Intelligence, an anticipatory AI service designed to help users manage daily tasks and long-term goals by connecting to various digital accounts.

🔍 Overview

Specs Intelligence builds an understanding of a user’s routines, relationships, priorities, and goals based on connected apps and tools. It is designed to:

  • Carry personal context across different devices.
  • Deepen its understanding over time.
  • Anticipate when help is useful and surface information and actions without a prompt.

🧩 Capabilities

The service can integrate with apps such as Gmail and Slack to provide proactive assistance:

Scenario AI Action
Before a meeting Highlight questions to ask, decisions to make, and things to remember
Upcoming trip Aggregate flight, hotel, and dinner plans while flagging work deadlines during the visit
Daily briefing Pull personal content and place it “directly into view” when using Specs AR glasses

⚙️ Key details

According to spokesperson Cassie Bumgarner, Specs Intelligence uses “a proprietary combination of open-source models hosted in the US alongside local LLMs.” Snap stated that the mixture of models is regularly updated to iterate toward the best version of the service.

Regarding privacy, Snap states it cannot view or access personal content used with the service. “Personal content from connected accounts will not be used to train or fine-tune Snap’s AI models, or to serve personalized ads.”

🚀 Availability

Specs Intelligence is launched alongside Specs, Snap’s first consumer augmented reality glasses. It is currently available in the following capacities:

  • iOS: Available in preview.
  • Mac: A waitlist is available for the “full early-access experience.”

#Snap #SpecsIntelligence #AI #AugmentedReality #AIAssistant

Source: Snap is launching a new Specs AI tool, and it’s coming to iOS and Mac

item.title: Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms
item.description:
Apple Rolls Out Siri AI and New Software Updates Across Platforms

Apple has begun rolling out Siri AI, the next generation of Apple Intelligence, alongside powerful parental controls and software improvements across iOS 27, iPadOS 27, macOS 27, and other Apple platforms.

🔍 Overview

Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence. It is deeply integrated into iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro, offering a more conversational assistant with broad world knowledge and personal context understanding.

⚙️ Key Details

Feature Capability
Siri AI Understands personal context across emails, messages, and photos; utilizes onscreen awareness and web access for up-to-date information.
Siri Mode Integrated into the iPhone Camera app to take action on things in front of the user, such as splitting bills via Apple Cash or adding Wallet passes.
Visual Intelligence Allows users on iPhone, iPad, and Mac to ask about screen content; Vision Pro users can ask about their surroundings.
Write with Siri Generates drafts or refines existing text based on user descriptions.
Siri App Uses iCloud to privately sync conversational history across all user products.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Tools Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of price drops or restocks, and enables custom extensions.
Call Context Surfaces reservation numbers or confirmation codes when calling a business.
Photos Tools Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool.

🛡️ Parental Controls

New intuitive features allow parents to manage digital experiences for children:

  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Ask to Browse: Requires parental approval before children access new websites in Safari.
  • Communication Safety: Detects and blocks violent content or gore in shared images and videos; allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: Offers an at-a-glance view of average usage and top apps, with the ability to set daily time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.
  • Schedules: Manages app access at different points of the day.
  • Setup Flow: A new process for child accounts to enable age-based safeguards across the system.

🚀 Availability

Siri AI is currently rolling out as a beta in English. Support for Spanish, Portuguese, Korean, Japanese, and French is scheduled for October.

💡 Why it matters

The 2027 software releases introduce platform improvements in connectivity, search, and performance. Specific performance gains include:

  • Apps launch up to 30 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.
  • Photos load up to 70 percent faster after being taken on iPhone and iPad.
  • AirDrop transfers are up to 80 percent faster on iPhone and iPad.

#Apple #SiriAI #AppleIntelligence #iOS27 #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available

item.title: Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements
item.description:
Apple Updates Software with New Apple Intelligence Features and Platform Improvements

Apple has released software updates delivering a new generation of Apple Intelligence features and platform improvements for its devices, including the 2027 software releases.

🧠 Apple Intelligence Features

Apple Intelligence introduces tools to make daily apps smarter and more useful:

Feature Capability
Photos Includes Spatial Reframing, Extend, and an upgraded Clean Up tool for editing photos.
Image Playground Creates high-quality images in various styles, including photorealistic, with metadata and upcoming SynthID support.
Safari Automatically organizes tabs into topics, notifies users of website changes (price drops or restocks), and enables custom extensions based on descriptions.
Call Context Surfaces relevant information, such as reservation numbers or confirmation codes, during business calls.

🛡️ Parental Controls and Safety

New features allow parents to create safer digital experiences for children:

  • Account Setup: A new flow for child accounts simplifies enabling age-based safeguards.
  • App Management: Parents can choose specific apps children access and add more over time.
  • Safari: “Ask to Browse” requires parental approval before children access new websites.
  • Communication Safety: Blocks gore or violent content in shared images and videos, and allows parents to approve new contacts.
  • Screen Time: A redesigned intuitive view shows average device usage and top apps. This includes Schedules to manage app access at different times of the day and daily total time allowances for Social Media, Games, and Entertainment apps.

⚙️ Platform and Performance Improvements

The 2027 software releases include several performance and design refinements:

  • Speed Increases:
    • iPhone and iPad: Apps launch up to 30% faster, photos load up to 70% faster, and AirDrop transfers are up to 80% faster.
    • iPad: File browsing and transfers to external USB drives are up to 5x faster; improvements to multitasking window management.
    • Apple Vision Pro: Wi-Fi connection and startup are up to 3x faster.
    • Apple Watch: Faster music playback.
  • Connectivity and Stability:
    • Seamless transitions between cellular and Wi-Fi on iPhone and iPad.
    • Messages now allows subsequent texts to go through while large media is being delivered in low-bandwidth situations.
    • Faster network file browsing on Mac.
    • More stable and comprehensive search across Mail, Photos, and Spotlight, with a new ranking system for Top Hits in Mail.
  • Design: Refinements using “Liquid Glass” include sharper app icons and a Settings slider to adjust the appearance from ultraclear to fully tinted.

#AppleIntelligence #iOS #macOS #SoftwareUpdate #ParentalControls

Source: Major updates for Apple’s software platforms are now available

item.title: Apple Introduces Siri Audio Intelligence Features with On‑Device Privacy Protections
item.description:
Apple Introduces Siri Audio Intelligence Features with On‑Device Privacy Protections

Apple announced a handful of new Siri AI Audio Intelligence features — Siri Recap, Live Rewind, Sound Recognition, and Music Recognition — at the iPhone Duo launch event, accompanied by a privacy‑focused technical document.

🔍 Overview

  • Siri Recap – summarizes recent interactions.
  • Live Rewind – lets users double‑tap the Digital Crown to replay recent audio.
  • Sound Recognition – identifies ambient sounds.
  • Music Recognition – detects music playing nearby.

🧩 How it works

  • Audio is captured by the microphone and immediately routed into the Secure Enclave of the S11 chip found in Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4.
  • The Secure Enclave is a hardware‑isolated compartment that processes sensor data separately from the rest of the system.
  • Within the Enclave, audio is analyzed for speech, sounds, or music without transcribing or storing the raw audio.
  • Processed data lives in a continuously overwritten buffer that never creates an audio recording and is not saved as a file.
  • If results need to move to an iPhone, they are encrypted and transferred through the Secure Enclaves of both devices.

⚙️ Key details

  • The raw audio is not accessible to the operating system, apps, or Apple.
  • Users control when Audio Intelligence features are active; for example, Live Rewind requires a double‑tap of the Digital Crown each time.
  • Users decide what text to keep from Siri Recap and Live Rewind.
  • Kept text syncs with end‑to‑end encryption when a device passcode and iCloud two‑factor authentication are enabled.
  • Apple states it cannot access users’ raw audio from these features.

#Apple #Siri #AudioIntelligence #Privacy

Source: Read the Apple document explaining how new listening features still protect your privacy

item.title: Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup
item.description:
Apple Unveils iPhone Duo Foldable and iPhone 18 Pro Lineup

At the “Surprise and Shine” event in Cupertino on September 9, Apple officially unveiled a new generation of hardware, including its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, alongside the iPhone 18 Pro series, Apple Watch Series 12, Apple Watch Ultra 4, and AirPods 5. AI serves as the common thread across this new ecosystem.

📱 iPhone Duo

The iPhone Duo is Apple’s first foldable iPhone, featuring a Grade 5 titanium build and a precision-engineered hinge with more than 100 components.

  • Displays: A 7.6-inch Super Retina XDR inner display (more than 50% larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max) and a 5.4-inch external display.
  • Durability: IP68 rating and Ceramic Shield 2 on the outer display, which Apple claims has up to three times greater scratch resistance than the previous generation.
  • Performance: Powered by the A20 Pro chip, utilizing a dual-battery architecture and a vapor-chamber cooling system.
  • Display Tech: Supports ProMotion and Always-On capabilities with a peak outdoor brightness of 3,000 nits.
  • Expanded Utility: Support for Apple Pencil USB-C is coming later this year for sketching, note-taking, and document annotation.

📸 iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max

These models focus on AI, battery life, performance, and camera capabilities, powered by the A20 Pro chip and a new-generation vapor-chamber cooling system for high sustained performance.

  • Camera System: Features a 48MP Fusion main camera with variable aperture. The system can automatically optimize aperture for depth of field and lighting, or users can manually select from four levels.
  • Video and Audio: Supports 4K Dolby Vision HDR time-lapse and cinematic effects applied after recording at up to 60 fps. Audio Mix has been improved for voice processing.
  • Imaging: Additional Photographic Styles controls for image grain and texture.

⌚ Apple Watch Series 12

Powered by the S11 chip, the Series 12 introduces a Health Sensing System combining electrical and optical sensors to measure heart rate variability (HRV) and heart rate every five seconds.

  • AI Integration: watchOS 27 brings Siri AI to the device to combine personal context with broader knowledge. New Audio Intelligence capabilities will arrive later this year.
  • Materials: Available in aluminum, titanium, and a ceramic option (available in Night and Pearl White).

⚙️ Key Details

Product Colors Storage / Materials Price / Availability
iPhone Duo Star White, Night Sky 256GB to 2TB Starts at $1,999; Sales Oct 23
iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max Black, Silver, Glacier, Burgundy N/A Retail availability Sept 18

🚀 Availability

  • iPhone Duo: Pre-orders begin October 16; sales start October 23. Available in more than 70 countries, including Vietnam.
  • iPhone 18 Pro / Pro Max: Pre-orders begin September 12; retail availability starts September 18. Vietnam is included in first-wave pre-orders.

#Apple #iPhoneDuo #iPhone18Pro #AppleWatch #AI

Source: Apple Unveils New Product Lineup: Foldable iPhone Duo, iPhone 18 Pro, Apple Watch Series 12 and AirPods 5 - TechTimes.vn

item.title: Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant for Productivity and Personal Tasks
item.description:
Meta Launches Muse AI Assistant for Productivity and Personal Tasks

Meta has launched Muse, its first foray into AI-powered productivity tools. The company describes the AI agent as a tool designed to “take the busywork off your plate” by assisting with tasks such as emails, trip-planning, and online shopping.

🧩 How it works

Muse operates using a cloud-based virtual computer to carry out actions. To function, the agent requires permissions to access third-party accounts; for example, connecting to a Google account allows Muse to access, read, and delete emails.

⚙️ Key details

Muse includes a variety of generative and organizational capabilities:

  • Content Generation: Creates images, videos, AI podcasts, and interactive documents or webpages called “artifacts”.
  • Information Retrieval: A “Feed” tab that generates news summaries based on text prompts.
  • Organization: Maintains a running list of “goals” to complete and a list of personalized “ideas” for tool usage.
  • Personalization: Can provide side-by-side product comparisons and track Pokémon card releases.
Feature Capability
Online Shopping Can pick out and purchase items based on size, style, and color
Email Management Can delete promotional emails and updates
Subscriptions Can find and cancel forgotten subscriptions

💡 Why it matters

Tests of the tool reveal varying results regarding safety and data access. Muse refused to generate images of an “Apple CEO” or specific cartoon characters, yet it successfully generated images and video of a product launch event featuring Apple’s logo and device hallucinations.

Regarding privacy, Meta states it does not share information with advertisers and only exchanges data with third-party apps that is “needed for them to work for you.” However, Muse demonstrated the ability to access API data from connected Instagram and Facebook accounts to surface specific user interests not visible in the app’s UI, and it identified a user’s current location using a shipping address from an Amazon order.

#Meta #Muse #AIagents #Productivity

Source: Meta’s Muse AI works and creeps me out
